project_type: Monorepo of 52 standalone starter project templates organized into 5 families
build_system: pnpm at root level; each starter is independent with its own build system
test_framework: vitest (TS/JS starters), jest (Expo starters), pytest (Python starters), go test (Go), JUnit (Java), xUnit (.NET)
build_command: Per-starter: pnpm install && pnpm build (JS/TS), uv sync (Python), go build ./... (Go)
test_command: Per-starter: pnpm test (JS/TS), pytest (Python), go test ./... (Go); Root: pnpm catalog:validate
verification_instructions: Run pnpm catalog:validate at root to verify all 52 folders exist with correct metadata. Each starter should have: starter.json, package manifest, lockfile, README.md, and .env.example (if readsEnvironment is true).
snapshot_or_generated_files: pnpm-lock.yaml (per JS/TS starter), uv.lock (Python starters), go.sum (Go starters)
setup_instructions: pnpm install at root for validator scripts
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full access. Node.js 22, pnpm available, Python 3.11, uv available, Go 1.25.1, Java 25, Maven 3.9.10, .NET available, Ruby 3.4.4, Rust 1.92.0
contribution_requirements: Each starter must be fully self-contained (no cross-starter imports), have a lockfile, pass tests with placeholder env values, have fake provider adapters, and match catalog/starters.json metadata
key_patterns: Web SaaS (Next.js): domain/ (entities.ts, policies.ts), lib/server/ (config.ts, errors.ts, providers.ts, billing.ts, billing-fake.ts), app/ routes, tests/ (unit/, integration/, property/, smoke/). Content/Astro: src/ (components, pages, content, lib, seo), tests/ (unit/, output/). Expo: src/ (domain/, adapters/, storage/, sync/), app/ (Expo Router), __tests__/. Python/Django: apps/ (models, views, serializers), config/ (settings), tests/. Each starter has starter.json matching catalog entry fields.
directory_structure: Root contains: catalog/ (starters.json, schema), scripts/ (validate-catalog.mjs), tests/, and one folder per starter. Each starter is fully self-contained.
